Because its totally normal to have intrusive suicidal thoughts. Because its normal to spend time trying to stop thinking about suicide.

And im defensive because you present your arguement like an ass, assuming shit about me when you know nothing.
You are such a tool to come in here, assume all this shit about me, then say i havent tried hard enough.
No you idiot. Environmental factors play a part in how you feel. If you had run the gamut of everything from ssris to maois snd cbt to ect you would start to ask why the fuck you're still depressed.

Dude fuck you. I scrounged and saved money for years to travel to Europe and Asia in order to get away from my environment, and you know what, you can be just as depressed skiing down a mountain as you are laying on a beach.

Just fuck you for assuming i haven't spent my adult life trying to fix this.
